requires.name: mistralrs
requires.why: The runner reads mistral.rs's own words for a request longer than the model's length or its KV budget, and for Metal kernels that don't compile, to map each to the run's reason; those words aren't an API, and were captured from 0.9.5. Another version may word them differently, so a full context could be reported as an engine error. A bump re-captures the fixtures.
